cohort.derivation: Recomputed from the exact 57-video divisions-off baseline. FN membership uses patched official 7um matching on baseline fragments; endpoint coordinates and the >10um test use original raw cached FrameDet nodes before smoothing, synthesis, or image-support projection.
cohort.exclusion_reconciliation_method: Official-unmatched endpoints are necessarily FNs. The remaining excluded FNs are the raw-absent remainder after subtracting eligible in-gate and above-gate FNs from the exact baseline FN total; the remaining raw-ineligible GT edges are selected official TPs.

affine_implementation_gate.rule: PASS iff >=50% of the exact >10um FN cohort falls within 10um

motion_axis_bounded_rule.interpretation: tail is not predominantly coherent tissue motion; motion axis is bounded near zero
motion_axis_bounded_rule.rule: PASS iff fewer than 50% fall within 10um after affine warping

execution.optional_deformation_field_reason: Skipped: no dependency/provenance expansion was needed to answer the affine gate.

fit.estimator: centered ordinary least squares; full-rank 4x3 design
fit.fit_source: All direct t->t+1 edges selected by the exact baseline tracker whose endpoints both exist in raw FrameDet, using those raw coordinates; no GT correspondence or image label is used to fit the transform.
fit.leakage_control: For each queried FN, refit after removing every selected-edge correspondence incident to either matched query endpoint. The target FN edge is absent by definition.

supersedes.reason: v1 measured final postprocessed CSV coordinates and therefore did not represent the actual raw FrameDet gate cohort
